title: Tower description of the integral compactly supported direct image
statement:
Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. On $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$ use the pulled-back integral ring sheaf $R_T=\mathcal O_{E,T}=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T$, not the discrete constant sheaf $\mathcal O_E$ [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Write $A_{n,T}=(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T$, $N/\ell^n=N\otimes^L_{R_T}A_{n,T}$, and $\operatorname{red}_TN=(N/\ell^n)_n$ [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized]. The categories $\Dbc$ and $\Dctf$ mean bounded constructible complexes and their finite-Tor subcategories [sk-def-sfb-constructible]; normalized constructible towers have common cohomological and Tor bounds and invertible derived reduction maps [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers].

Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth of pure relative dimension $d$, with a compactification $f=\bar f\circ j$, where $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ is open and $\bar f:\bar X\to Y$ is proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and let $M\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$. Use derived module pullback and tensor over these ring sheaves [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], and the separately derived compact-support composite $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}=R\bar f_*j_!$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Then:

1. The tower $Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM$ is normalized constructible. If $[a,b]$ is a Tor-amplitude interval for $M$, its levels have Tor amplitude in $[a,b+2d]$.
2. There is a canonical isomorphism in $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$
$$Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\simeq R\varprojlim_nRf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(M/\ell^n).$$
Here the finite levels are restricted to $R_Y$-modules before taking the total derived inverse limit; $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}=R\bar f_*j_!$ is independent of the compactification up to canonical natural isomorphism. Consequently
$$(Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M)\otimes^L_{R_Y}A_{n,Y}\simeq Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(M/\ell^n),\qquad \operatorname{red}_YRf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\simeq Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM.$$
3. For $K\in\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, $f^*_{\mathcal O_E}K\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and its reductions are $f^*_{\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(K/\ell^n)$. The projection formula
$$Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}(M\otimes^Lf^*_{\mathcal O_E}K)\simeq Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\otimes^LK$$
holds in $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$.

proof.text: Construct normalized reduction geometry and the ordinary/derived adjunction-normalized limit presentations. Destructure their existence only in this proof, without defining any data by choice.
Apply constructible compactification coherence, which is independent of the selected reduction presentation.

For each compactification obtain the whole-tower comparison, normalized image, Tor bounds, constructibility of the integral image and its limit, and invertibility of reconstruction. Evaluate the whole-tower comparison: hom_eq identifies the actual base-change arrow as an isomorphism; every evaluation preserves isomorphisms and finiteComparison is an isomorphism, so finiteBaseChange is an isomorphism.

Use ordinary pullback/tensor preservation to construct M tensor f* K in the source constructible category; apply the image constructibility just proved to this new input. Apply tensor preservation to the constructible direct image of M and K for the other endpoint.
Apply integral projection-mate invertibility to the same M and K, and assemble all conclusions by conjunction and existential introduction.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs (1)-(3), assembly with whole-tower finite-base-change deduction and constructibility of both projection endpoints.

Supplies derived completeness of integral constructible objects and equality Dbc=Dctf; these are coefficient infrastructure, not an alternate purity route.
Generic compactification comparison, with independence and cocycle on integral inputs, directly supplies the compactification clause; no purity result is used.
Specifies admissible coefficient rings and contains integral constructible inputs in the domain of the compactification comparison.
Generic integral pullback preservation is needed to ensure the projection-formula input stays constructible.
Generic closure of integral constructible complexes under the uncompleted derived tensor product supplies both projection-formula inputs.
Generic quasi-compactness criterion verifies the open-extension limit theorem hypothesis directly from finite type over k and separated compactification, without an uncited Noetherianity argument.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth of pure relative dimension $d$, with a
compactification $f=\bar f\circ j$, and $M\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.

1. The tower $Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM$ is normalized constructible, with
   the Tor bounds of $M$ widened by $2d$.
2. There is a canonical isomorphism in $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$
   $$
   Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\simeq R\varprojlim_nRf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(M/\ell^n),
   $$
   where $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}=R\bar f_*j_!$, independent of the
   compactification; consequently
   $(Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,Y}}\mathcal O_{E,Y}/\ell^n\simeq
   Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(M/\ell^n)$ and
   $\operatorname{red}_YRf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\simeq Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM$.
3. $f^*_{\mathcal O_E}K$ has reductions $f^*_{\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(K/\ell^n)$, and for
   $K\in\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ the projection formula
   $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}f^*_{\mathcal O_E}K)\simeq Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\otimes^{\mathbf L}K$
   holds in $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$.

proof.text:
(1) $\operatorname{red}_XM$ is normalized constructible with the Tor bounds of $M$
([det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized], part (1) of [sk-prop-sp-integral-towers]). By [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] and
[det-sp-tower-bound-uniform] its image under $Rf_{!,\bullet}$ is constructible
with bounds widened by $2d$, and its reduction maps are the composites of the
isomorphisms $b$ of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image] with $Rf_!$ of the
(invertible) reduction maps of $\operatorname{red}_XM$, hence isomorphisms.

(2) $R\bar f_*$ and $j_!$ commute with reduction modulo $\ell^n$ (reduction is
the cone of $\ell^n$) and with $R\varprojlim$ ($R\bar f_*$ is a right adjoint;
$j_!$ is exact and commutes with products on the replete site, Stacks, Tag
09BP), and $M\simeq R\varprojlim_nM/\ell^n$ since $M$ is derived complete [def-pe-derived-complete]. Hence
$R\bar f_*j_!M\simeq R\varprojlim_nR\bar f_*j_!(M/\ell^n)=R\varprojlim_nRf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(M/\ell^n)$.
By (1) and the equivalence of [det-sp-normalized-equivalence], this limit lies in $\Dbc(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and
reduces to $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}(M/\ell^n)$; equivalently
$\operatorname{red}_YRf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M\simeq Rf_{!,\bullet}\operatorname{red}_XM$. Independence of
the compactification holds in the tower category (levelwise, by the finite
statement), hence after $R\varprojlim$.

(3) Pullback is exact on module sheaves and commutes with extension of scalars,
so $(f^*K)/\ell^n=f^*(K/\ell^n)$, and inverse image preserves
$\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E)$ without completion (part (3) of [sk-prop-sp-integral-towers]). Tensor products of objects of
$\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E)$ stay in this category ([sk-lem-int-tensor]), with reductions the tensor products
of reductions. The tower projection formula (an isomorphism of towers, being
levelwise the finite projection formula) applied to
$\operatorname{red}_XM$ and $\operatorname{red}_YK$, followed by $R\varprojlim$ and (2), gives the
integral projection formula.
